author: reek
body: Parallax and bump mapping from Codex [Device] AST: a procedural brick wall. Each pixel builds a per-texel height field (bricks raised, mortar recessed, bevelled edges), offsets its texture coordinate along the view direction by that height (parallax, so the bricks appear to stand proud of the mortar), then shades with a normal derived from the height gradient (bump) under an orbiting light. Single pass, all procedural. Reference site's "parallax mapping" technique. Float math from DeviceMath.

author: reek
body: Height in 0..1: 0 in the mortar grooves, ramping to 1 across a bevel onto the brick face. Rows are offset half a brick.

author: reek
body: Parallax-offset the coordinate along the view slant, rebuild the height there, take a finite-difference normal, and light it with an orbiting key light. The brick albedo varies per brick; the mortar is grey.
